attributes.text: Nudge counts scrolls and unlocks with an Android accessibility service. Nothing is tracked, and there's no score, until it's on.
attributes.originalText: Nudge counts scrolls and unlocks with an Android accessibility service. Nothing is tracked, and there's no score, until it's on.

attributes.text: Find Nudge under Downloaded apps (or Installed apps) and switch it on.
attributes.originalText: Find Nudge under Downloaded apps (or Installed apps) and switch it on.

attributes.text: Optional: allow Display over other apps to show the floating scroll-count bubble.
